title: LLM Engineering
description: Master Prompt Engineering, RAG, and AI application design step-by-step with simple English and bullet points across 25 lessons.

lessons.title: 1. What are LLMs?
lessons.explanationHtml:
Concept Overview

  • Understanding What are LLMs? in Large Language Model applications.

Real-World Analogy

  • Like training a super-intelligent digital assistant to read, summarize, and answer questions for your team.

Industry Application

  • Building AI chatbots, document Q&A tools, and automated text generators.

Common Pitfalls & Fixes

  • Treating LLMs like deterministic databases instead of probabilistic text predictors.

Practice Exercise

  • Test What are LLMs? using an AI API or playground environment.
lessons.codeExample:
// What are LLMs? Example
console.log("What are LLMs?");
